observations.trace: validate_source checks source identity, grid and urban admission, establishments, property bindings, vista ordering and weather. Urban validation delegates active and distant lists independently and validates each street/yard, compound, garden and parish. Earlier full grounding consumes each combined support identity once; neither partial source validation nor this read proves all alternate producer paths.
observations.remaining: Full scene admission, producer reachability, exact identity aliases and separate market topology policy remain open.

observations.contract: Terrain mesh triple and collar bounds
observations.trace: For sampled geometry the mesh producer appends an entire three-index triangle when its centre passes the filter. For owned geometry the selected owned_mesh_components producer also extends indices with three per accepted triangle; collider_mesh_with_transition chunks that same vector in threes. This rules out an incomplete index remainder on these paths if they return normally. Quantized landform validation requires collar_cm*2 < half_width_cm and collar_cm < half_length_cm; selected fixed variation is1200 basis points, so its ideal minimum varied half-width is0.88 of the original and remains larger than the collar width.
observations.remaining: Finite computed attributes, overflow/capacity, native rendering/collision, all geometry variants and floating rounding require separate qualification. The public general collar accepts a wider range; whether it must maintain a full-weight inner core is a policy question, and no seed or runtime behavior was probed.

observations.trace: Vista grid validation bounds width and depth independently and presented geographic surface admission accepts centered expanding rectangles. lod_transition_weight uses only width for a common radius, while the selected sampled presentation and geographic source use actual width/depth to advance the inner rectangle. The static example in the conditional finding gives differing north-edge heights when two hypothetical rings are accepted.
observations.remaining: The selected city dispatcher constructs square centered rings, and neither a supported producer of the rectangular data nor actual native/visible output was established. Source admission and the conditional height calculations do not imply a completed scene.

observations.trace: Segovb653/654 independently recorded historic source bodies; Segovb655 applies the exact previously registered connected1964 read once with zero fresh reread. Historical Adler299 covers1959/1960; Adler300 covers1961–1964. Two exact Windows locator metadata qualifications point at the prior774 root producer receipt, now hash- and source-proof matched.
observations.remaining: The historic locator044 was explicitly not read by that reviewer, its available normalized export has a different pre-export hash, and the original pre-export body is not claimed recovered. No reviewer attribution or earlier774/059 state is promoted to3821 or a current lens verdict.

conditional_findings.first_contract: At an accepted boundary between adjacent vista rings, height morphing must use the actual ring extent in each direction or the admission policy must explicitly exclude rectangular rings.

symbolic_source_witness.playable: Assume a sampled 2-by-2 flat zero terrain with spacing0.5, hence half extent(0.25,0.25).
symbolic_source_witness.fine: Centered 9-by-5 ring, spacing1, constant height0, level0, origin0, with matching environment samples. Half extent(4,2).
symbolic_source_witness.coarse: Centered 9-by-9 ring, spacing2, constant height10, level1, origin0, with matching environment samples. Half extent(8,8).
symbolic_source_witness.point: At scene point(0,2), fine grid north boundary and a coarse ring cell boundary. Fine common radius=2, width-derived half extent=4, transition width=min(2,4) max1=2, so weight=(2-(4-2))/2=0. Fine presented height remains0; its playable-edge stitch has outside distance1.75 and spacing1, so the clamped vista weight is1. Coarse ring with no further coarser ring or playable stitch supplies10. Source rectangle clipping can emit both boundary vertices at the same coordinates with heights0 and10 if the remaining mesh/source work succeeds.
symbolic_source_witness.admission_qualification: These dimensions, spacing, sample values, origins, ordering and expansion satisfy the inspected grid and presented-ring predicates under otherwise valid input. This is symbolic source analysis, not execution of a scene or renderer.

conditional_findings.normal_path_counterevidence: The inspected sample_city_vista dispatcher constructs width=depth=spec.side and origin0. Other supported producers and actual retained rectangular input remain unproved.
conditional_findings.effect_and_policy: A mismatch can form a vertical seam at the shared rectangular-ring boundary. Actual renderer/ground topology, interpolation at all boundary points, whole-scene acceptance, normal producers and gameplay or visible impact remain open.
conditional_findings.repair_direction: Resolve whether rectangular rings are supported; if so derive morph distance from both axis extents while preserving the admitted square-ring behavior and other seam contracts. This is an audit recommendation only.
conditional_findings.alias_qualification: The width-only reporting metric and shifted playable seam concern different inspected first contracts; exact historical aliases and all other overlapping cases remain open. No historical unique count or checkpoint3821 claim.
